title: OpenAI 用最高 90% 折扣从 Anthropic 手里抢走大客户，AI 价格战开打
summary: OpenAI 正在用最高 90% 的折扣从 Anthropic 手中抢夺大客户（10月25日，北京时间），AI 巨头正面价格战全面开打。
summary_en: OpenAI is reportedly offering discounts of up to 90 percent to win away Anthropic's largest customers, according to The Information. Rippling, Replit and DataCamp have shifted spending to OpenAI, with one bank's ChatGPT seats doubled at lower per-user cost. Anthropic's growth slowed from Q2 to Q3, while pricing pressure from Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Kimi grows. Anthropic also published guidance and a GitHub migration kit recommending a single-agent architecture over multi-agent setups, and co-founder Jack Clark moved his self-improving-AI prediction to 2027. Nvidia open-sourced Flora, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, for cheap robot video labeling.
body:
OpenAI 正在用最高 90% 的折扣从 Anthropic 手中抢夺大客户（10月25日，北京时间），AI 巨头正面价格战全面开打。

OpenAI
- OpenAI 最高打九折抢 Anthropic 大客户 — The Information 爆料：Rippling 的编码负载中 OpenAI 份额从 16% 升至 52%，Anthropic 从 57% 跌至 18%；Replit 在年逾 1 亿美元合同上拿到 30%+ 折扣，Anthropic 的增长从 Q2 到 Q3 明显放缓——价格战直接改写厂商份额
  https://the-decoder.com/openai-offers-discounts-up-to-90-percent-to-poach-anthropics-biggest-customers

Anthropic
- Anthropic：单智能体架构优于多子智能体 — Anthropic 官方建议企业把子智能体合并为单一智能体、按需加载上下文，并发布 GitHub 迁移套件；其对比中单智能体速度约为多智能体的 2 倍，Claude Code 新版系统提示词缩短 80% 以上
  https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-says-one-ai-agent-beats-many-subagents-now-that-models-can-handle-complexity-alone
- 联合创始人 Jack Clark 将自我改进 AI 的时间点提前到 2027 年 — 这位 Anthropic 联合创始人以其模型评估 TasteVal 的进展为依据上调预期，是判断前沿模型能力曲线的重要信号
  https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-co-founder-jack-clark-moves-his-prediction-for-self-improving-ai-forward-to-2027

Qwen（阿里通义千问）
- Nvidia 开源机器人视频标注系统 Flora，基于三个微调 Qwen3.5 模型 — Flora 标注一小时机器人视频仅需 72 美分（GPT-6 Astra 为 88 美元），且错误捕捉优于竞品——显示 Qwen3.5 已成为机器人数据管线的事实底座
  https://the-decoder.com/nvidia-open-sources-flora-to-make-robot-video-labeling-125x-cheaper-than-gpt-6-astra

DeepSeek
- 中国放行 DeepSeek、MiniMax 模型海外部署 — 据 Digitimes 报道，DeepSeek 与 MiniMax 完成海外模型注册合规通道，国产模型出海部署正式获批，直接影响海外 API 竞争格局
  https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPdDh5VWJWOEg3WTVranpFRmZkTElMd0k4MW1CNTV4LWRZZlVwQUhWbGlmSE1TUkMyV0RQRGhEV3lPVjNWajBNWlRYSFFRYTFTcWUzanczSzFuUHNnSHlUMmhKWU9zMDZVQXYyYzRGd2hxYzFGaDg3REVreHYwQzVaTVNyMG1CdUlf?oc=5
